strings.name: Tarciana Medeiros
strings.role: President and CEO of Banco do Brasil
strings.summary: Tarciana Medeiros worked as a market vendor and teacher before joining Banco do Brasil in 2000. After branch, insurance, credit and customer-management roles, she became its first female president in 2023. In 2026 she faced operating pressures from agricultural loan defaults and weaker earnings.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through November 17, 2026. Conflicting birthdays mean only 1978 is retained. Reports of a possible leadership change do not establish her departure. The executive presidency is distinct from board chairmanship, and bank earnings from personal income.
strings.influence.rationale: Became Banco do Brasil's first female leader, participating in financial inclusion and the management of a major public bank.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Bachelor's degree in business administration, with postgraduate professional studies in management, business and marketing, and leadership, innovation and management; these are not presented as an economics degree or research master's.
strings.facts.f2.label: Early career
strings.facts.f2.value: From Campina Grande, Paraíba, she worked in market trading and teaching before banking.
strings.highlights.h1.title: From branch work to bank leadership
strings.highlights.h1.text: Progressed within Banco do Brasil through retail, insurance, credit and customer-management roles before becoming president.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Agricultural credit and risk management
strings.highlights.h2.text: Publicly discussed agricultural loan defaults, debt renegotiation and collection in 2026; those assessments represent bank management's statements.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Press reports leadership pressure
strings.timeline.t1.text: Broadcast reported that weaker earnings increased pressure for replacement; it described a possibility, not an official departure announcement.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Earnings-call remarks reported
strings.timeline.t2.text: UOL reported her discussion of agricultural defaults and stronger collection. This is the report date, not independent confirmation of each borrower's intentions.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Presidential inauguration ceremony
strings.timeline.t3.text: Became Banco do Brasil's first female president, with Lula attending the ceremony; the ceremony date is not conflated with appointment documents.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Takes customer-relationship role
strings.timeline.t4.text: Became executive manager in the retail, micro and small business and individual customer division, responsible for customer-relationship cycles.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Becomes executive manager in lending and financing
strings.timeline.t5.text: The official biography dates her move into executive management in lending and financing solutions to this year.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Takes insurance commercial executive role
strings.timeline.t6.text: Became commercial executive superintendent at BB Seguros, not CEO of the insurance group.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Takes first management position
strings.timeline.t7.text: Entered management and subsequently worked in branches and retail management units across several regions.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joins Banco do Brasil
strings.timeline.t8.text: Began her banking career at the Posto da Mata branch in Bahia.
